dedupe_keys.name: hurricane matthew digicel haiti mobile network functionality by commune october 2016

description: Two snapshots published by the Flowminder Foundation on the Humanitarian Data Exchange give the proportion of Digicel Haiti's mobile network radio cells working normally in each commune (admin level 2) after Hurricane Matthew struck Haiti on 4 October 2016, as of 15 October and 25 October 2016. Each snapshot has a CSV table, a shapefile of the CNIGS 2013 commune boundaries joined to the share of active sites, and a PDF map report in English and French. Together they show how far the operator's network was still down in the south-west, and how much it had recovered ten days later. Coverage: all communes of Haiti, two dates, one operator (Digicel, the larger operator). Format and access: CSV, shapefile (ZIP) and PDF, free to download from HDX under Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO). Caveats: shares of cells, not of subscribers or traffic; one operator; only two points in time; the cause of each outage (power, backhaul or damage) is not given. Simulation uses: calibration and validation of telecom outage and restoration models for tropical cyclones, cascading failure from power to mobile sites, and emergency response planning. Related records: Flowminder's population movement datasets used the same network data; the FCC DIRS reports and the GAO review of Hurricane Maria describe US counterparts.
